{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pho family''' was the family alias used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jai Maruk]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] while they were aboard the commercial freighter ''[[Reasonable Doubt]]'' on their way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. They were accompanied by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who was disguised as an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], and Jedi Knight [[Maks Leem]] claimed to be a friend.<ref name="dr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

The team could not keep their cover for long; when the [[Phindar Spaceport]] came under attack by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], they exposed their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] nature to defend civilians.<ref name="dr" />
